verdict.rationale: Docs show only two API operations (auth and companyCaptable read access) while the UI offers extensive functionality—bulk granting, vesting automation, compliance flags, financial reporting, trading/settlement—with no documented API equivalents, and no OpenAPI/llms.txt spec was found (404s). missing for 10: evidence of write/automation endpoints (granting, vesting, compliance, reporting) mirroring UI features, a public API reference or OpenAPI schema.
